items.source: Note: special considerations apply for asynchronous request processing. For more details see AsyncHandlerInterceptor.
items.translation: 注意： 异步请求处理适用特殊注意事项。有关详细信息，请参阅 AsyncHandlerInterceptor。

items.source: handler - the handler (or HandlerMethod) that started asynchronous execution, for type and/or instance examination
items.translation: `handler` - 启动异步执行的处理器（或HandlerMethod），用于类型和/或实例检查

items.source: Exception - in case of errors
items.translation: Exception - 在发生错误时

items.source: request - current HTTP request
items.translation: request - 当前 HTTP 请求

items.source: response - current HTTP response
items.translation: response - 当前 HTTP 响应

items.source: In an asynchronous processing scenario, the handler may be executed in a separate thread while the main thread exits without rendering or invoking the postHandle and afterCompletion callbacks. When concurrent handler execution completes, the request is dispatched back in order to proceed with rendering the model and all methods of this contract are invoked again. For further options and details see org.springframework.web.servlet.AsyncHandlerInterceptor
items.translation: 在异步处理场景中，处理器可能在单独线程中执行，而主线程在未渲染或调用`postHandle`和`afterCompletion`回调的情况下退出。当并发处理器执行完成后，请求将被重新分发以继续渲染模型，并且此合同的所有方法将再次被调用。有关更多选项和详细信息，请参阅org.springframework.web.servlet.AsyncHandlerInterceptor

items.source: Note: Will only be called if this interceptor's preHandle method has successfully completed and returned true!
items.translation: 注意：仅当此拦截器的 `preHandle` 方法成功完成并返回 `true` 时才会调用！

items.source: Note: Interceptors are not ideally suited as a security layer due to the potential for a mismatch with annotated controller path matching. Generally, we recommend using Spring Security, or alternatively a similar approach integrated with the Servlet filter chain, and applied as early as possible.
items.translation: 注意： 由于拦截器可能与注解控制器的路径匹配存在不匹配的风险，因此它们并不适合作为安全层。通常，我们建议使用 Spring Security，或者采用类似的方案集成到 Servlet 过滤器链中，并尽可能早地应用。

items.source: As with the postHandle method, the method will be invoked on each interceptor in the chain in reverse order, so the first interceptor will be the last to be invoked.
items.translation: 与`postHandle` 方法一样，该方法将在链中的每个拦截器上按逆序调用，因此第一个拦截器将是最后被调用的。

items.source:
A HandlerInterceptor gets called before the appropriate HandlerAdapter
triggers the execution of the handler itself. This mechanism can be used
for a large field of preprocessing aspects, or common handler behavior
like locale changes. Its main purpose is to allow for factoring
out repetitive handler code.
items.translation: HandlerInterceptor 会在合适的 HandlerAdapter 触发处理器本身的执行之前被调用。此机制可用于各种预处理方面，或像区域设置更改之类的通用处理器行为。其主要目的是允许将重复的处理器代码提取出来。

items.source:
Typically an interceptor chain is defined per HandlerMapping bean,
sharing its granularity. To be able to apply a certain interceptor chain
to a group of handlers, one needs to map the desired handlers via one
HandlerMapping bean. The interceptors themselves are defined as beans
in the application context, referenced by the mapping bean definition
via its "interceptors" property (in XML: a <list> of <ref>).
items.translation: 通常，拦截器链是针对每个 HandlerMapping Bean 定义的，与其粒度保持一致。若要向一组处理器应用特定的拦截器链，需要通过一个 HandlerMapping Bean 来映射所需的处理器。拦截器本身在应用程序上下文中定义为 Bean，并通过映射 Bean 定义中的"interceptors"属性进行引用（在 XML 中：一个包含<ref>的<list>）。

items.source:
HandlerInterceptor is basically similar to a Servlet Filter, but in
contrast to the latter it just allows custom pre-processing with the option
of prohibiting the execution of the handler itself, and custom post-processing.
Filters are more powerful, for example they allow for exchanging the request
and response objects that are handed down the chain. Note that a filter
gets configured in web.xml, a HandlerInterceptor in the application context.
items.translation: HandlerInterceptor 基本上与 Servlet Filter 类似，但与之不同的是，它仅允许自定义预处理（并可选择禁止执行处理器本身）以及自定义后处理。Filter 功能更强大，例如它们允许交换在链中传递的请求和响应对象。请注意，Filter 在 web.xml 中进行配置，而 HandlerInterceptor 则在应用程序上下文中进行配置。

items.source:
As a basic guideline, fine-grained handler-related preprocessing tasks are
candidates for HandlerInterceptor implementations, especially factored-out
common handler code and authorization checks. On the other hand, a Filter
is well-suited for request content and view content handling, like multipart
forms and GZIP compression. This typically shows when one needs to map the
filter to certain content types (for example, images), or to all requests.
items.translation: 作为基本准则，细粒度的处理器相关预处理任务是 HandlerInterceptor 实现的候选项，特别是提取出的通用处理器代码和授权检查。另一方面，Filter 非常适合处理请求内容和视图内容，例如多部分表单和 GZIP 压缩。这通常体现在需要将过滤器映射到某些内容类型（例如图像）或所有请求时。

items.source:
DispatcherServlet processes a handler in an execution chain, consisting
of any number of interceptors, with the handler itself at the end.
With this method, each interceptor can post-process an execution,
getting applied in inverse order of the execution chain.
items.translation: DispatcherServlet 处理一个执行链中的处理器，该执行链由任意数量的拦截器组成，处理器本身位于末尾。通过此方法，每个拦截器都可以对执行进行后处理，且按执行链的逆序应用。

items.source: The default implementation is empty.
items.translation: 默认实现为空。

items.source: modelAndView - the ModelAndView that the handler returned (can also be null)
items.translation: modelAndView - 处理器返回的 ModelAndView(也可以为 null)

items.source: ex - any exception thrown on handler execution, if any; this does not include exceptions that have been handled through an exception resolver
items.translation: ex - 如果在处理器执行过程中抛出任何异常；这不包括已通过异常解析器处理的异常。

items.source: The default implementation returns true.
items.translation: 默认实现返回true。

items.source:
DispatcherServlet processes a handler in an execution chain, consisting
of any number of interceptors, with the handler itself at the end.
With this method, each interceptor can decide to abort the execution chain,
typically sending an HTTP error or writing a custom response.
items.translation: DispatcherServlet 处理一个执行链中的处理器，该执行链由任意数量的拦截器组成，处理器本身位于末尾。通过此方法，每个拦截器都可以决定中止执行链，通常发送 HTTP 错误或写入自定义响应。

items.source:
Callback after completion of request processing, that is, after rendering
the view.
items.translation: 请求处理完成后的回调，即在渲染视图之后。

items.source: Interception point after successful execution of a handler.
items.translation: 处理器成功执行后的拦截点。

items.source: Interception point before the execution of a handler.
items.translation: 处理器执行前的拦截点。

items.source: handler - chosen handler to execute, for type and/or instance evaluation
items.translation: handler - 选定的处理器，用于类型和/或实例评估。

items.source: true if the execution chain should proceed with the next interceptor or the handler itself. Else, DispatcherServlet assumes that this interceptor has already dealt with the response itself.
items.translation: 如果为 `true`，则执行链将继续进行到下一个拦截器或处理器本身；否则，DispatcherServlet 假定该拦截器已经处理了响应。

items.source: Juergen Hoeller
items.translation: Jürgen Hoeller
